# Dynamind Studios - Autonomous Software Engineering & Operational AI Systems

> Dynamind Studios is an elite software engineering and artificial intelligence studio founded by Juan Pablo Toro. We architect high-conversion web ecosystems, bespoke Operational Cores (PMS/KDS/ERP), and multi-agent workflow automations (n8n/Supabase/LLMs) that liberate business founders from operational bottlenecks (D0).

## Core Systems & Engineering Standards

- **Zero-Drop High-Conversion Frontoffice**: Dynamic multi-page web applications with 60 FPS cinematic motion, hyperframes timelines, and zero generic templates.
- **Operational Cores (PMS / KDS / ERP)**: Real-time cash registers with blind balancing, atomic reservation calendars, printable thermal receipts, and real-time inventory deduction.
- **Autonomous Agent Swarms**: n8n workflows with WhatsApp Baileys integration, invoice extraction via multimodal OCR, conversational booking agents, and dynamic pricing engines.
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Total machine readability via llms.txt, MCP Server Cards (SEP-1649), Agent Skills Discovery RFC, OpenAPI 3.1, and Cloudflare Agent-Ready architecture.
- **Defensive Cybersecurity Hardening**: Row Level Security (RLS), HMAC SHA-256 webhook signatures with constant-time verification, Argon2id hashing, and Kill-Switch fail-safes.

## Live Production Works & Case Studies

- **Hacienda Campestre Los Quimbayas**: Luxury eco-tourism glamping platform with atomic cabin calendar, blind cash register, guest intake form, and multi-currency engine.
- **Dra. Lorena Gómez Studio**: Medical aesthetic clinical ecosystem with laser treatment catalogue, procedural quizzes, before/after comparisons, and automated appointment scheduler.
- **Kall Gastrobar & Speakeasy**: Dark luxury gastronomic platform with mixology vault, interactive cocktail customizer, live table booking, and kitchen display integration.
- **Imperium Barber Studio**: Modern grooming parlour system with barber chair allocation, real-time service builder, commission calculation, and WhatsApp reminders.
